## What's Changed
* Add the website, a reports API and in-app feedback and error reporting by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/80
* Send reports to api-romm-client.ijacks.co.uk by default; ReportsUrl "off" turns reporting off by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/81
* Discord status: name the emulator without the platform in brackets by @stevejackson80 in https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/pull/82


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejackson80/RomM-Client/compare/v0.8.3...v1.0.0-rc.1
